note: The candidate font controls the sbix glyph offset array; for the selected old_gid the start offset is zero while the following offset is positive.
The validation compares ordering and size but does not require the glyph start offset to be non-null, so offset zero is treated as a usable glyph record.
The positive following offset and zero start offset produce a large enough delta to compute a nonzero glyph_data_length.
The length derived from the malformed offsets is passed to SBIXGlyph::copy.
Adding the null offset selects the global Null(SBIXGlyph) object instead of bytes inside the sbix table, while preserving the attacker-derived copy length.
The data array belongs to the Null(SBIXGlyph) object but is copied for glyph_data_length bytes.
The copy loop reads past the one-byte Null glyph data storage, producing the global-buffer-overflow read.
